help_text:
Admin commands:
/whoami Show current chat ID
/welcome Show welcome message
/setwelcome text Set /start welcome message
/buttons Show welcome buttons
/setbuttons Button 1|Button 2|Button 3 Set welcome buttons
/note customer_id text Add an internal note, also works by replying to a customer message
/shownote customer_id Show note, also works by replying
/block customer_id Block customer, also works by replying
/unblock customer_id Unblock customer
/customer customer_id Show customer profile, also works by replying
/history customer_id Show recent history, also works by replying
Use the buttons under customer cards to view history, view notes, set notes, block or unblock.

customer_usage: Use: /customer customer_id, or reply to a customer message with /customer.

history_usage: Use: /history customer_id, or reply to a customer message with /history.
